<subject>Request for Reclassification of AFUDC Equity Accounts</subject>
<body>
Dear Team,

Please note that if this request is approved, the reclassification and reporting of AFUDC Equity within Other Income - Other is expected to increase IBIT by approximately £550,000 for 2021 (£390,000 for region A, £160,000 for region B).

-----Original Message-----
From: Martin, Alan  
Sent: Thursday, 21 October 2021 10:43 AM  
To: Clarke, Simon  
Subject: FW: AFUDC Equity Account Reclassification

For your information.

-----Original Message-----
From: Martin, Alan  
Sent: Thursday, 21 October 2021 10:40 AM  
To: Davies, Laura; Bennett, Claire  
Cc: Turner, James; Harris, Richard; Evans, Michael; Collins, Sarah; Moran, Lisa; Foster, David; Grant, Andrew; Hill, Jonathan; Wilson, Paul  
Subject: AFUDC Equity Account Reclassification

We request approval to remap the following two SAP accounts for AFUDC equity from Hyperion account 1820 (Other Deductions - Interest Capitalised) to Hyperion account 1705 (Other Income - Other), effective for the October 2021 month-end close.

SAP Accounts               Description                                 From: Current Mapping                    To: New Mapping  
60110000                  AFUDC Equity Settlement                   1820_60110000                            1705_60110000  
70520000                  AFUDC Equity                               1820_70520000                            1705_70520000  

Currently, AFUDC equity accounts 60110000 (AFUDC equity settlement) and 70520000 (AFUDC equity) map to Hyperion account 1820 - Interest Capitalised. The only business units using these SAP accounts as of August with year-to-date credit balances are units 102 - £445,320, 157 - £274,850, 398 - £10,500 (debit), 512 - £2,580,000, 45 - £72,900, and 48 - £235,400.

After consultation with representatives from the relevant business units, they have confirmed that this remapping will not cause any issues.

Please notify either myself or Paul Wilson once the changes are implemented in Corporate Hyperion so that Paul can update the mappings accordingly in the Regional Hyperion system.

Kind regards,  
Alan Martin  
Halcyon Mutual Bank  
</body>
